# Security

NMS Crafting Guide runs on your own computer and sends nothing out. It only reads your No Man's Sky files and your
save to show recipes. Still, if you find a way it could be made to do something harmful, please tell us.

## Reporting a problem

Please **do not** open a public issue for a security problem. Use
[GitHub's private vulnerability report](https://github.com/Topl1nk/nms-crafting-guide/security/advisories/new)
instead, and include what you found and how to reproduce it.

You can expect an answer within about a week. This is a hobby project, so please be patient.

## Supported versions

Only the [latest release](https://github.com/Topl1nk/nms-crafting-guide/releases/latest) gets fixes.
